req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that DELETE /players/{squadNumber} must remove the row from the players table so that a subsequent GET returns 404. The endpoint is DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player returns 204 and subsequent GET by squad number returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent player returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — delete the lowest squad number (1) and verify persistence; (4) STC — full state transition: player exists → delete → 204 → GET returns 404 (row gone); (5) DT — delete already-deleted player returns 404 (idempotency boundary). All tests use exact status code assertions and verify DB persistence via follow-up GET calls.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_returns_404():
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_player_full_state_transition_exists_to_gone
preconditions: Player with squad_number=26 (Nahuel Molina) exists in the database
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: GET /players/ — verify player is absent from full list
expected: State EXISTS: GET returns 200 with squad_number=26
Full list does not contain squad_number=26
trace: R-PLAYER-021: state transition from existing to deleted; GET returns 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_full_state_transition_exists_to_gone():
    get1 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert get1.status_code == 200
    assert get1.json()['squadNumber'] == 26
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    get2 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert get2.status_code == 404
    all_resp = client.get('/players/')
    assert all_resp.status_code == 200
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in all_resp.json()]
    assert 26 not in squad_numbers

test_delete_player_full_state_transition_exists_to_gone()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_highest_squad_number_boundary_persists():
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    gone_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert gone_resp.status_code == 404
    adjacent_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/25')
    assert adjacent_resp.status_code == 200
    assert adjacent_resp.json()['squadNumber'] == 25

test_delete_highest_squad_number_boundary_persists()
